description: This file defines the usage and interface for a lookup table system in PyTorch Inductor, specifically handling template lookup tables through the LookupTableChoices class, including basic and customized usage examples.

classes.name: LookupTableChoices
classes.description: A class providing functionality for managing lookup tables and choices, allowing for customization through subclassing.

methods.name: _get_lookup_table
methods.description: Method intended to retrieve the lookup table; meant to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: make_lookup_key
methods.description: Method to generate a lookup key based on kernel inputs and operation name; customizable in subclasses.
